issues.legal_issue: A borrower challenging both enforcement measures and the auction sale must calculate the statutory pre-deposit under Section 18 of the SARFAESI Act using whichever is higher: the debt claimed in the Section 13(2) notice or the amount stated in the sale certificate.
The debt due for calculating the Section 18 pre-deposit includes the liability together with the interest claimed by the secured creditor.
A borrower challenging the auction sale cannot count or adjust the sale proceeds paid by the auction purchaser toward the borrower’s Section 18 pre-deposit.
